method: FFmpeg decoded the complete track to mono 16 kHz PCM. Local faster-whisper 1.2.1 base.en transcribed the full waveform with beam sizes 5 and 1. Both passes agreed on the technical terms and task. Visual frames were sampled at three-second intervals across the clip.
summary: A moving vehicle records coordinates over time to form a GPS trajectory.
Buildings, interference and measurement errors displace observations from roads.
Identifying which roads were travelled is the map-matching problem.
Use the observed trajectory and the underlying network to recover the most likely sequence of roads. The closing identifies PathSnap.
additional_requirements: No additional quantitative scoring or implementation rule was heard. The route-sequence objective agrees with the written guidelines.
